description: Convx Web 1.0.2 — Complete end-to-end Playlist Engine with SQLite persistence, Apple Music-style UI, Universal Add-to-Playlist, and YouTube/YouTube Music playlist import.

changelog.title: Playlist Engine & UI
items: Full end-to-end playlist management with SQLite database persistence and Drizzle ORM.
Apple Music-inspired Playlist Grid and Detail View with 6 color gradient presets, 4-track mosaic thumbnails, total duration calculation, and Play All / Shuffle All controls.
Universal 'Add to Playlist' action on track cards with Cupertino modal to create or add tracks on the fly.
YouTube and YouTube Music playlist import supporting lockupViewModel, playlistVideoRenderer, and musicResponsiveListItemRenderer with 1-click 'Simpan ke Perpustakaan' library import.

changelog.title: Player & Queue Polish
items: Fixed queue store method call in TrackList to use reactive addToQueue with visual feedback.
Independent Playlists and Queue tabs in Library navigation.

changelog.title: Audio Streaming Engine
items: Adoption of YouTube Android client Format 18 (MP4 container with stereo AAC-LC) featuring ratebypass=yes with no PO Token burst limits.
Resolved 502 Bad Gateway and MediaError format errors during track playback.
Fixed the 0:28 audio repeat bug where audio looped back to 00:00 while lyrics and time progressed.
Full HTTP Range support enabling instantaneous seeking to any timestamp.

changelog.title: Standalone Repository Reorganization
items: Complete removal of 1,434 legacy Android files to streamline the codebase.
Promoted web components (frontend, backend, server, Dockerfile) directly to the repository root.
Updated GitHub Actions Docker publishing workflow with multi-stage BuildKit caching.
